messages:
Rachel Moore: Quick kickoff

We have sign-off from StratusAI to do a customer story. Summary: 5x reduction in median latency for their chat service and 18% infra cost savings after moving to Redwood Dedicated. Need interview, quote, legal clearance, and lead routing.

Yusuf Khan: Great. Who's our primary contact and are they OK on-record?

Rachel Moore: Priya Desai, VP Eng. She agreed to a 20-30 min on-record interview and a short 1-2 sentence quote. Wants a technical and an exec line.

Priya Singh: I can conduct the interview. Available Tue/Thu next week. Want to capture one or two screenshots of perf but Priya requested redaction of any internal IDs.

Tom Becker: I'll pull the perf graphs and a small table for the case page. Aim to have visuals in Drive by EOD Monday.

Maya Lopez: I'll draft the landing copy and two social variants (dev + exec). Also planning a gated tech appendix to capture high-intent leads.

Rachel Moore: Callouts to highlight: 5x P50 improvement, 18% cost reduction from smarter batching + cache, and smoother rollouts due to Dedicated pools. Avoid mentioning vendor names they migrated from.

Yusuf Khan: Routing: trials -> trials@redwood.ai, enterprise -> emea-sales@redwood.ai, tag source=case-stratus. @routing-bot can you confirm mapping?

routing-bot: Routing confirmed. Also added form field: "Interested in Dedicated" checkbox and dropdown for "Workload type". Gated appendix mapped to enterprise-sales.

Priya Singh: Draft interview Qs: 1) baseline pain, 2) migration steps, 3) developer workflow changes, 4) SLO improvements, 5) one-line for header.

Tom Becker: Uploaded graphs redacted per request. Table in Drive:
Metric | Before | After
P50 latency | 140ms | 28ms
P95 latency | 560ms | 130ms
Cost per 1k reqs | baseline | -18%

Added captions describing test conditions.

Maya Lopez: Draft quote sent to Priya Desai: "Redwood let us deliver consistent low-latency inference and freed our team to build features, not babysit infra."

Priya Desai (StratusAI): Fine with that but please change "babysit" -> "manage". Also ok with a slightly longer technical quote for the case body.

Rachel Moore: Legal check: sending quote and redacted images. @legal-bot any immediate issues?

legal-bot: Please ensure no PII in images and avoid superlatives like "best" or direct competitor comparisons. Submit final assets for review; turnaround ~48 hours. Also need logo usage permission.

Yusuf Khan: Stratus sent logo and a short release email. Uploading to Drive.

Tom Becker: Also trimmed an internal config screenshot to remove customer IDs and API keys. Replaced with a sanitized snippet.

Maya Lopez: Proposed hero copy A/B: A: "StratusAI cut median Latency 5x with Redwood Dedicated." B: "Predictable low-latency at scale: StratusAI's switch to Dedicated." Which one should be used for dev vs exec channels?

Priya Singh: Prefer B on the public page. A is fine for technical posts.

legal-bot: Received assets. Clearance pending minor redactions. Approval expected within 48 hours. Ref LEG-2025-012 once done.

Yusuf Khan: Webinar idea: 30 min with Priya + rapid demo. Use gated appendix to capture higher-intent attendees. Thoughts?

Maya Lopez: Yes. Promo copy drafted and a registration form template (email + role + current monthly inference spend optional). Will link gated appendix as follow-up.

Priya Desai (StratusAI): Happy to do webinar, prefers it after the case study publish so customers see the write-up first.

routing-bot: Lead tags added: utm_source=case-study, campaign=stratus-q1, region=emea. Gated leads route to enterprise-sales@redwood.ai.

Tom Becker: Finalized visuals in Drive and added alt text.

legal-bot: Approval granted with required redactions. Document LEG-2025-012. You may publish once copy and assets are updated.

Rachel Moore: Proposed timeline:
- Mon 2025-01-06: final assets in Drive
- Wed 2025-01-08: design and QA
- Tue 2025-01-14: publish case study + social drip
- Thu 2025-01-16: webinar with StratusAI (guest Priya Desai)

Maya Lopez: I'll prepare the gated appendix and a tech appendix link for devs. Also adding a 1-sentence hero for A/B test:
- Hero A: "StratusAI sped up inference 5x with Redwood Dedicated."
- Hero B: "Consistent low latency at scale: StratusAI's story."

Priya Singh: B on site, A for Twitter/Dev channels.

routing-bot: Campaign scheduled and webhooks connected for lead routing.

Rachel Moore: Great work team. Once live, paste the URL here and we'll close the thread. :tada:

routing-bot: Live URL scheduled: https://redwood.ai/case/stratusai (publish 2025-01-14 09:00 UTC). Closing thread after publish.
